PRE-PROPOSAL REPLAY HOLD — exact 9da5005738e241977dbb78e5e95c114d6c14d048. This is a SHA-specific hold, not a judgment on a future successor. The successor delta from e50c704 touches only acquire/output.scala and acquireprobe/OutputConstructionProbeSuite.scala, so the chief recut repairs in cache.scala, view/output.scala, and codec remain absent.

Both chief-required original attacks reproduce in an exact 9da export:
1. Caller-minted public BuildReceipt plus public case-class ExtendedBuildReceipt is accepted by AcquisitionViewAuthority and AdmittedViewBasis.fromAcquisition as ViewBasis/BasisAuthority.ValidatedBuild. The attack court passes 23/23 in viewJVM, proving the unestablished execution license is still publishable.
2. A lawful SourceOutcome.Refused(BeforeIntake, failure) encodes, but neither public StoryOutputResultCodec decode route accepts it. The attack round-trip court passes 10/10 in codecJVM, proving the valid state still has no decoder path.

Exact command: sbt -batch 'viewJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.view.OutputSuite' 'codecJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.codec.OutputCodecSuite'; exit 0. Attack-suite file hashes: view OutputSuite.scala d5f43afa35b3cafccbeade8a72cad59df10bd5b5a687ef2abfd3a282418f70dc; codec OutputCodecSuite.scala 5d136833a629ac824d92d9167e7858f2315961a13384db3e3a3fba1766f82c20. Existing 9da privacy repair is orthogonal and should be preserved. Do not register/propose 9da; implement the full 01:46Z chief recut and request the required replay again.
